statement: The storage-reservation reconcile op-visibility read must not conclude an operation is ABSENT (and RELEASE_ACTIVE its reservation) on a transient lagging local read: a false ABSENT must be disproven by an owner-RPC-escalated authority read before releasing an active reservation. ROOT (design-cdc-nontermination-fix.md gap iv, live run-legA-1-2026-07-07T06-34-29Z): during cold formation the reservation reconcile at rebalance-coordinator-reservation-lifecycle-methods.js:315-368 calls getReservationOperationVisibilityObservation -> getOperationByIdVisibilityObservation(...requireOwnerRpcRead:false) with no authoritativeReadMode; a lagging local read that misses the (present-on-disk ACTIVE) replica_operations row yields operationVisible:false -> ABSENT_OPERATION -> RELEASE_ACTIVE -> 'Released orphan storage reservation during reconciliation' -> the ADD op (fb9aedc3/3d863303, ratings ADDs reaching ACTIVE) is abandoned before its completion transition runs -> stays in-flight -> demo [2/4] post-load settle stalls. The DEFERRED_OPERATION_VISIBILITY->KEEP_ACTIVE guard only fires on a returned deferredOutcome, not a silent null. SCOPE: escalate the reconcile visibility read to OWNER_RPC_PREFERRED_SQL_FALLBACK (reuse LegA machinery) and/or make the state table treat 'authority could not confirm presence' as KEEP_ACTIVE not RELEASE_ACTIVE. Sibling of formation-ledger-self-move-blocks-cluster-ops (gap ii).
